text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: It was while participating in a children's Christmas event hosted by the Mejiro family.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Everyone~, are you having fun making your wreaths~?
Please feel free to decorate them however you'd like~.

text_block_list.name: Participating Girl
text_block_list.text:
Ugh... the little star won't stick...
We're gonna run out of time...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Don't you worry, we have pl~enty of time.
I shall lend a hand as well~.

text_block_list.name: Participating Girl
text_block_list.text: ! Thank you, big sis! Okay, so, I need you to hold down the star! And then—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Besides, she is very calm,
so she might be ideal for dealing with children.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Well...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
"...Seeing Bright like that
feels rather refreshing, doesn't it?"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yes. She's usually remarkably laid-back, so
it feels more like she's the one being taken care of...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Indeed.
Could one say she is adept at being pampered, perhaps—

text_block_list.name: Young Bright
text_block_list.text:
Oh my~?
Where did the carrot pudding go~?
There was so much of it right here~.

text_block_list.name: Young Ardan
text_block_list.text:
"...Here you go, carrot pudding.
They're making more for us, so take your time and enjoy it, okay?"

text_block_list.name: Young Bright
text_block_list.text:
Howawa~! Lady Ardan~,
thank you very much~♪

text_block_list.name: Racetrack Staff
text_block_list.text:
"—From these reserved seats, you can enjoy the race
away from the hustle and bustle regardless of the weather,
and further ahead..."

text_block_list.name: Young Bright
text_block_list.text:
Fwaah~.
The sun is so warm and cozy~.

text_block_list.name: Young McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Shall we take a walk together, Bright?
Here, take my hand...

text_block_list.name: Young Bright
text_block_list.text:
Holding hands like best friends with Lady McQueen~!
Yaaay~♪

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
...Because she gets so happy about it.
I just end up lending a hand without thinking.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: I found it a little surprising.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It's true that she takes things at her own pace,
but it just takes her a bit longer—it doesn't mean she can't do it.
choice_data_list: (And I even let myself be happy about that—)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Oh my~?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Bright.
Why are you making wreaths too?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Everyone invited me, you see~.
However, it proved rather difficult.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, is that so?
In that case, let me give you a hand—
choice_data_list: No, I'm sure it'll be fine.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It might take some time,
but if we wait, she's sure to see it through.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Fufufu.
...Trainer-sama~?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Once it is finished, please do display it in your room.
I shall pour my heart into making it~.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: ...Are you sure you don't need any help?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
"Lady Ardan, I appreciate your concern~.
However――"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Since Trainer is here today, I will do my best on my own~.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Yes~. When my dear Trainer is by my side, I want to do my best with my own strength as much as possible.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: And I want you to watch over it.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Me...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Because they are someone
who will wait alongside me.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I suddenly remember.
The day I first met her.
And that single leaf gently swaying in the breeze—
choice_data_list: Yeah. I'll wait as long as it takes.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Ufufufu. Yes~.
I look forward to our long and wonderful time together~.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Well...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Fufufu.
It seems there was no need to worry after all.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Now then, to celebrate the event's success~.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
I'm relieved everything wrapped up without a hitch.
Thank you so much for your hard work, everyone.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Your wreath is lovely, Bright.
Would you mind telling me about what inspired it?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Of course~âª
The doll in the middle is me, and the Santa
next to it is you, Trainer~.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Because they are someone
who brings me so much happiness~♪

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe.
I suppose this is what people call a 'feast for the eyes.'

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
"...It's gotten quite late, hasn't it?
What should we do about dinner?"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
"How about checking out the Christmas market?
I heard they're holding one over there~."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: After that, everyone drank hot cocoa together, warming both body and soul.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for all your hard work at the event.
It was a huge success, so I'm very relieved.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
"...Here is something for Bright before we head home.
A Christmas present from all of us."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
I chose a planner for this year.
Please fill it with lots and lots of
plans with me, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
My goodness! Thank you so very much~!
I am so delighted~♪
choice_data_list: Shall we go buy some pens next time, then?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: "I told them that was my Christmas present to them."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Howawa~! Even you,
Trainer-sama~.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Thank you all so very much.
I shall put it to use with the utmost care~♪

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for all your hard work at the event.
It was a huge success, so I'm very relieved.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
"...Here is something for Bright before we head home.
A Christmas present from all of us."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
I chose a planner for this year.
Please fill it with lots and lots of
plans with me, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
My goodness~! Thank you ever so much~♪
I shall take great care of it~.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Fufufu~♪ An after-party at the amusement park
with all my favorite people~♪

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Hawaa~! Trainer-sama,
the carousel is so sparkly~.
choice_data_list: Since we're here, shall we go ride it?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Yeees~♪
You come along with us too, Trainer~.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Lady McQueen~, Lady Ardan~.
Yoo-hoo~!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
"...They really get along so well, don't they?
Just look at Bright's wonderful smile."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Yes, they look so happy...
It's adorable.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Yaaay!
Ufufufu♪

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Fufufu~♪ An after-party at the amusement park
with all my favorite people~♪

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Even so, there really is quite a huge crowd.
It looks like it will be difficult to enjoy the attractions.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, it is quite all right~. Just the memory of coming
here today with everyone is more than enough~.
